name: Ira
title: David's Priest and Commander
summary: Ira is a name that appears several times in the Bible, most notably as Ira from Jair who served as priest for King David, as well as Ira from Tekoa and Ira from Ittai who were among David's mighty warriors. These men were close associates and faithful servants during David's reign.

keyEvents.title: Ira from Jair, David's Priest
keyEvents.description: Ira, the son of Jair, served as priest (or advisor) to King David and held a prominent position at the court.

keyEvents.title: Ira from Tekoa among David's Heroes
keyEvents.description: Ira from Tekoa is mentioned as one of David's thirty mighty warriors who distinguished himself in battle.

keyEvents.title: Ira son of Ikkesh, among the Thirty
keyEvents.description: Ira, the son of Ikkesh from Tekoa, is listed among David's thirty heroes in the book of Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Ira from Ittai in David's warrior list
keyEvents.description: Ira from Ittai is mentioned as another of David's mighty warriors, listed among the thirty brave men.

keyEvents.title: Ira as commander of the eighth division
keyEvents.description: Ira, son of Ikkesh from Tekoa, led the eighth monthly military division with 24,000 men during David's organization of the army.
